description: We are Team Boca Juniors, enthusiastic students participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Thrissur. We are passionate about space science, technology, and innovation. We aim to use NASA’s open data to develop creative solutions to real-world problems. We welcome motivated team members skilled in coding, data analysis, research, design, and presentation. Beginners eager to learn and collaborate are also welcome. Let’s innovate together!Team Name: Boca Juniors
